name: Caio Terra Guard Retention System
description: A study map for Caio Terra Online's publicly listed one-legged-X and half-guard recovery lessons.
summary: Caio Terra Online's defense archive offers specific guard-recovery lesson choices, including one-legged X against a toreando pass and half-guard recovery.
overview: Start with the guard and passing situation you can identify, then use the archive to find a matching lesson. These individual entries support a focused reading route; the public archive does not present them as a single named guard-retention system.

related_content.relationship: Alternative for established side-pin recovery, with separate elbow and knee-escape sections in its outline.

fits: You are looking through Caio Terra Online for a lesson matching one-legged X or half-guard recovery.
consider_alternative_if: Your opponent has already established a side pin: Danaher Pin Escape Fundamentals has explicitly indexed side-position escape sections.

includes: The official defense archive lists ONE LEGGED X VS TOREANDO PASS, HALF GUARD RECOVERY and a separate Q&A HALF GUARD RECOVERY entry.
The archive provides distinct lesson destinations that can be compared with a specific guard problem.
limits: This map covers those named archive entries, rather than a verified comprehensive Caio Terra guard-retention curriculum.
The public archive establishes lesson subjects; the full instructional videos require membership and have not been reviewed here.

start_here.title: Match the lesson to the guard you actually lost
start_here.task: Take one guard-passing exchange from your notes or footage and describe the guard at the last moment you can identify it. Compare that description with ONE LEGGED X VS TOREANDO PASS and HALF GUARD RECOVERY in the official archive. Select a matching entry only when its named situation fits; if neither does, keep the exchange as a separate problem rather than using a generic recovery label. The Q&A entry is an additional half-guard study destination for members.
